'''LX-466''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], he was stationed in an [[Imperial Outpost (Dantooine)|Imperial Outpost]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Here, he hired an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] soldier to patrol the area and destroy any [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] resistance. The soldier successfully killed a stranded Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] and two scouts that accompanied him. LX-466, impressed with his soldier's work, tasked him with delivering some rations to a [[Dantari]] informant. The soldier did so dutifully, but LX-466 had one more task for him, which involved delivering a recording rod to an Imperial courier.

The soldier once again performed the job adequately, much to LX-466's delight.

==Behind the scenes==
LX-466 is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' which gives players a short series of quests.
